  "gas_lab_output is required unless engine_state is will_not_start" when `gas_lab_output` is None and
  `symptom_dna["environmental_conditions"]["engine_state"]` is not `"will_not_start"` (a missing key counts as not).
- **R2 Aggregator.** `labs/comlab/comlab/core/lab_pipeline_aggregator.py` `LabPipelineAggregator.process`: with no
  `gas_lab_output`, `select_perception_lambda` gets `lambda_measured=None`; `perception_result` is

  either detector. `_build_sanitized_payload` puts `"gas_lab_output": None`. With gas, nothing changes.
- **R3 Composition.** `apps/wired/wired/composition.py`: a helper `_gasless_non_starter(triage, gas_inputs)` is True
  when `triage["engine_state"]` is `will_not_start` and all five `_GAS_LOW_IDLE_KEYS` are missing (per `_missing`). In

  In `_diagnose`, `gas_output` is None when the helper is True; otherwise `_run_gaslab` runs as today.
